run_train_loop: run the MTA transformer model training loop with distributed GPU support and checkpointing
run_main_cli: run the training CLI with a config file and optional dot-list override arguments
build_train_args: build a TrainArgs dataclass with model, data, optimizer, distributed, and checkpoint configuration
build_train_state: build a TrainState object tracking optimizer steps, accumulation steps, scheduler, and dataloader state
validate_train_args: validate TrainArgs configuration including vocab size, data paths, and distributed parallelism settings
